data.explanation: This is a repair bill from a plumber for work done at your home. It must be paid by the deadline shown (10 days after the invoice date), using the invoice number as the payment reference (Verwendungszweck). If you don't pay in time, the company can send a reminder (Mahnung) and possibly charge late fees. Keep this invoice: the labor and call-out portions of craftsman invoices (Handwerkerleistungen) can often be claimed on your German tax return under §35a EStG, so it may be worth mentioning to a tax advisor or including in your tax software.
